description:
Intents with code blocks in a file, so you can see in-progress work and team conflicts before editing.

Pass startLine + endLine to narrow to a range; the result then reports the exact overlap and warns when it hits a teammate's active intent.

endLine.description: End line (1-based, inclusive). Provide with startLine to narrow to a range.

filePath.description: Path to the file (relative to repo root)

repoOrigin.description: Git remote origin URL. Auto-detected from repoPath via git if not provided.

repoPath.description: Local path to the repository root

startLine.description: Start line (1-based). Provide with endLine to narrow to a range.

name: get_intents_for_file
